entities.summary: Edgar Bauer was a German writer, journalist and political philosopher associated with the Young Hegelians. The younger brother of Bruno Bauer, he became known in the 1840s for radical political and anti-religious writings. His 1843 book Critique's Quarrel with Church and State led to a conviction for sedition and four years' imprisonment at Magdeburg. Edgar Bauer was a philosophers & thinkers from Charlottenburg (1820-10-07, Charlottenburg–1886-08-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
